topic: Data table structure for facility and sensors
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the required data format. Initially, a request was made for a table containing connections, coefficients, virtual facilities, and sensors. It was clarified that the coefficients are not needed; instead, someone should simply send [me] the name of the table to establish the correct format.
decisions: The required data structure needs to include connections, virtual facilities, and sensors.
action_items: [p1] needs to send [me] the name/format of the required data table.
